comparison.objective: Extend a spring-return tape and make one accurate 300 mm mark on a board.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand resists tape retraction while the other aligns and dabs a pen.
comparison.success_condition: A single released pen mark lies within the specified measurement tolerance while the tape was extended past it.
comparison.reason: Bimanual holding and fine alignment are generic; no adjustable mechanism, lock retention, or dynamic validation is involved.
